# Job Description - Solution Architect

> **Position**: Solution Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking a talented Solution Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and oversee the implementation of technology solutions for specific business problems within Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, ensuring alignment with our Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) while delivering practical, scalable solutions that meet business requirements.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#solution-design--development]

### Solution Design & Development

- Design comprehensive technology solutions for specific business requirements and use cases
- Create detailed solution architectures that integrate multiple systems, platforms, and technologies
- Develop solution blueprints, technical specifications, and implementation roadmaps
- Ensure solution designs align with Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) principles and standards
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#technical-leadership]

### Technical Leadership

- Lead technical design sessions and architecture reviews for assigned solutions
- Guide development teams through solution implementation and delivery
- Provide technical mentorship and guidance to developers and junior architects
- Collaborate with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#integration--implementation]

### Integration & Implementation

- Design integration patterns and APIs for solution connectivity
- Oversee solution implementation ensuring adherence to architectural standards
- Support DevOps practices and CI/CD pipeline integration for solutions
- Coordinate with infrastructure teams on deployment and operational requirements
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#stakeholder-collaboration]

### Stakeholder Collaboration

- Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and constraints
- Collaborate with product managers on solution feasibility and technical approach
- Partner with enterprise architects to ensure solution alignment with broader architecture
- Support sales teams with technical solution presentations and RFP responses
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#documentation--governance]

### Documentation & Governance

- Create comprehensive solution documentation including architecture diagrams and technical specifications
- Maintain solution architecture artifacts and design decisions
- Participate in architecture governance processes and design reviews
- Contribute to solution patterns and reusable architecture components
page_texts.9:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#domain-ownership--responsibilities]

### Domain Ownership & Responsibilities

- **Architecture Artifacts**: Own and maintain domain Architecture Artifacts including Enterprise Architecture Framework (EAF), Service Design Package (SDP), System Security Plan (SSP), and Technical Reference Package (TRP)
- **Product Roadmap Collaboration**: Work with Product Teams and provide input to domain roadmap and ecosystem planning
- **Business Architecture**: Own the Business Architecture (MITA Business Processes) and work with Modeling Teams to ensure accurate business processes for the solution are being deployed
- **Data Architecture**: Know domain data and relationships to other systems and solution components
- **Technical Architecture**: Own the Technical Architecture including how the domain solution is deployed, configured, accessed, by whom, interfaces, partners, monitoring tools, and software stack
- **Industry Awareness**: Stay current with industry trends and actively seek out enhancements and optimizations
- **RFP Participation**: Participate in domain RFPs and participate in Orals presentations as needed
- **Architecture Reviews**: Lead domain architecture reviews for both Preliminary Architecture Review (PAR) and Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB)
- **DDI Collaboration**: Be assigned to DDIs (Design, Development, and Implementation projects) and work with DDI Architects and Product Engineering teams to ensure no gaps in deliverables and quality outcomes
- **End-to-End Knowledge**: Maintain comprehensive understanding of domain interactions with all solution components
- **Transition to Operations**: Help facilitate Transition to Operations from DDI to Shared Services
- **Shared Services Relationship**: Maintain relationship with domain Shared Services team and serve as the last line of defense (L5) for domain production issues

---
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in relevant technical field
page_texts.12:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and system design
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience with enterprise software development and integration
- **Preferred**: 3+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government systems
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#solution-architecture-skills]

#### Solution Architecture Skills

- Solution design and modeling using architecture frameworks
- Architecture modeling tools (Markdown, Mermaid, Lucidchart, Draw.io, UML, C4 Diagramming)
- Systems integration and API design patterns
- Technology selection and evaluation methodologies
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#technology-expertise]

#### Technology Expertise

- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) with focus on solution implementation
- Integration technologies, APIs, middleware, and messaging systems
- Database technologies and data integration patterns
- Modern software development frameworks and platforms
- Container technologies and microservices architecture
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#development--implementation]

#### Development & Implementation

- Proficiency in multiple programming languages (Java, C#, Python, JavaScript)
- Understanding of software development best practices and design patterns
- Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD, and automation tools
- Knowledge of testing strategies and quality assurance practices
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for solution design, code generation, and problem-solving
- AI agents and automation tools for development and architecture workflows
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Associate
- Solution architecture or technical architecture certifications

page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#industry-experience]

### Industry Experience

- Experience in healthcare technology solutions and Medicaid systems
- Knowledge of healthcare workflows and business processes
- Understanding of HIPAA, MITA, and healthcare compliance requirements
- Experience with Health and Human Services interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, IX4HS, NIEM)
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#domain-expertise]

### Domain Expertise

- Experience with recipient engagement platforms and digital health solutions
- Knowledge of claims processing, eligibility, and enrollment systems
- Understanding of healthcare data standards and interoperability
- Experience with security protocols including Secure Messaging, ADA Section 508, FedRAMP
- Experience with Generative AI solutions for healthcare and government applications
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#technical-specializations]

### Technical Specializations

- Experience with healthcare-specific technologies and platforms
- Knowledge of government technology requirements and compliance
- Understanding of enterprise data integration and migration strategies
- Experience with legacy system modernization and cloud transformation

page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Solution Design**: Ability to design comprehensive, scalable technology solutions
- **Systems Integration**: Expertise in integrating diverse systems and technologies
- **Technical Communication**: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
- **Problem Solving**: Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Requirements Analysis**: Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements
- **Stakeholder Management**: Skills in working with business and technical stakeholders
- **Project Collaboration**: Experience working within project teams and delivery frameworks
- **Value Delivery**: Focus on delivering business value through technology solutions
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#leadership-competencies]

### Leadership Competencies

- **Technical Leadership**: Ability to guide technical teams and influence technical decisions
- **Mentoring**: Capability to develop junior team members and share knowledge
- **Collaboration**: Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills
- **Adaptability**: Ability to work in fast-paced, changing environments

page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#solution-delivery]

### Solution Delivery

- Design and deliver high-quality solutions that meet business requirements
- Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and principles
- Support successful implementation and deployment of designed solutions
- Maintain solution documentation and architecture artifacts
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/solution-architect.md#technical-excellence]

### Technical Excellence

- Stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices
- Contribute to architecture standards and solution patterns
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams
- Support continuous improvement of solution delivery processes
